$comment: Performance budgets enforced in CI. Raise a number only with a deliberate, reviewed reason — these exist to catch slowdowns, not to be rewritten when one is found.

bundle.$comment: Gzipped bytes of the production build in dist/. entryJs is a ratchet set from the measured baseline (390 kB) with ~3% headroom, not a target — the critical path is genuinely too heavy and should come down, so lower this number as chunks are lazy-loaded.

vitals.$comment: Lab thresholds measured on the built bundle under CPU/network throttling. lcpMs and cls are real targets. tbtMs is a ratchet from the measured baseline: the landing route currently blocks the main thread for ~3s while the 390 kB entry chunk parses and the hero animates — that is a known regression to fix by code-splitting, and this number should come down with it, never up.
